name: About page renders its hero and numbered 'What you get' list
description: The About page server-renders its hero heading and a 'What you get' section containing a three-item numbered list with two-digit ordinals.

planSteps.description: Verify the hero heading reads 'Personality is a trajectory, not a type.'
Verify the 'What you get' section renders a vertical numbered list of exactly three items, each beginning with a two-digit ordinal (01, 02, 03) followed by a bold title and a description sentence.
